name: Build a hub-and-spoke linking strategy
prompt: Design an internal linking strategy for our blog.
expected_behavior: Reads .agents/<productname>/product.md for topics and conversion targets
Fetches the sitemap/key sections if only a domain is given
Identifies pillar hubs and groups cluster spokes by topic
Returns a cluster map plus specific source->target links with anchor text and link type
Ends with the top 5 priority links and their rationale

name: Orphan page rescue
prompt: Find pages with no internal links pointing to them and fix it.
expected_behavior: Flags orphan pages from the supplied/crawled inventory
Assigns each orphan to the right cluster
Recommends specific links to rescue them
Only links pages that actually exist in the inventory

name: Anchor text strategy
prompt: What anchor text should we use for these internal links?
expected_behavior: Recommends descriptive, varied anchors (no exact-match repetition)
Mixes branded, keyword-rich, and natural-phrase anchors
Explains the relevance rationale for each link
Avoids over-optimization that reads as manipulative

name: Boost money pages
prompt: Make sure our conversion pages get enough internal links.
expected_behavior: Flags priority/conversion pages that are under-linked relative to value
Recommends links from relevant high-authority pages
Limits cross-cluster links to avoid diluting focus
Links for the reader's journey first, SEO benefit second
